text: Henrik + Alice - 10th anniv Sat. dinner @ that Italian place they got engaged in. remind me to text them that morning
Florin engaged!! asked Demi on the beach in Porto last wk. she said yes before he finished the sentence apparently

Kemal - mum's op Thurs at 8am, gallbladder. he's driving her in & staying till she's out of theatre. v anxious, kept saying she's 74 & the anaesthetic worries him more than the op. his brother Mehmet can't get off work till Fri. ring him Thurs evening, and maybe drop a lasagne round Sat so he doesn't have to cook

call w/ Reggie re Finn's stag do. Prague, 3 nights, leaves Fri 14th at silly o'clock (6am flight). I'm sorting the flights, he's doing the itinerary. Finn doesn't want anything too messy - his fiancee Chloe made him promise no tattoos. need everyone's passport names by Sun night. also Reggie wants matching t-shirts, vetoed
Hana - wedding dress fitting tomorrow at 2. her sister Ines flying in from Lisbon for it
Alfie's bday next Tues. hinted hard about a new chess set, the wooden kind w/ weighted pieces
Kevin & Femi wedding cancelled. split up over summer. don't bring it up w/ his mum
Gabriel - interview @ Santos & Kumar Weds at half 10. terrified. need to send good luck msg the night before
dentist Mon 9:15. then bins. then post office before 12
Aurelio - started at the council last Mon. ask how first fortnight's gone

Abigail's parents ruby anniversary - 40 yrs on the 3rd. family lunch Sun at 1 at the golf club, she's doing the cake (lemon drizzle, her mum's fave). her brother Hassan's flying back from Dubai for it but only lands Sun morning so might be late. Abigail asked if I can help w/ a slideshow of old photos - need to scan them by Fri
Anan / Hassan - both @ the hen do this weekend?? check w/ Eilidh who's driving
Chloe's dog Pickle had surgery yday, lump removed, waiting on biopsy. she's a wreck. check in tmrw morning
Ali proposed to Akira Sat night at the top of Arthur's Seat. ring hidden in a flask lid lol. wedding prob 2028
Alessia - vegan now, also no mushrooms. for Fri dinner
remind me - Nia's driving test the 12th at half 9. text her the day before + ask how it went that evening
Laura & Ignacio - anniv dinner Fri 7pm, I'm babysitting their twins. bring snacks
Mehmet said his dad retiring end of Nov after 35 yrs at the depot. surprise do planned for the Sat after. Mehmet v proud
Lila - nervous re her viva next Thurs morning. said she's barely sleeping. don't forget good luck text Weds night
Nikhil Kumar (Nik) - moving to Leeds in a fortnight. new job @ an architecture firm, starts the Mon after
Eduardo - grandad passed Sun. funeral Fri at 11 in Porto, flying out Thurs. message him this evening
Adriana's engagement party Sat 8pm, her flat. gift? she mentioned wanting nice wine glasses
Hana + Finn - 1st wedding anniv next Sun. paper. could do framed print of their venue
chat w/ Femi after footy. knee still bad, physio Tues. thinking of packing in 5 a side
Kemal's sister Lila getting married in June. he's best man (well, best brother). already stressing re speech
Reggie - got the promotion!! senior ops mgr from 1 Dec. his wife Demi wants to take him out Fri
Florin's mum in hosp since Mon - chest infection. he's going up tmrw after work. need to ring him the wk after to see how she is
Alice - flat viewing Sat morning, 2 bed in Leith. she & Henrik want to be in by Xmas

Gabriel's interview went well! 2nd round next Fri at 3pm - a presentation to the board this time, 20 mins on their digital strategy. he's way less nervous now, said the panel were lovely. his girlfriend Alessia's helping him practise. ask him that eve how it went, and if he gets it we're doing drinks the Sat after
Akira's brother Kemal visiting from Osaka in Nov. she wants recs for a Highlands trip
Ines - into pottery now, wheel class Weds nights. wants her own kiln eventually haha
note to self: renew passport b4 Easter. book car MOT for the 28th
Eilidh & Kevin wedding - Sat 22nd, ceremony 1pm @ Glasgow uni chapel. reception after. I'm doing a reading, practise it this wk
Anan - his gran 90 on Sunday. big party at the community hall Sat afternoon. he asked if I'd take photos

Mrs Popescu next door - knee replacement Mon. her son Florin away w/ work till Weds, his wife Adriana's due any day so can't help either. Mrs P says she's fine but she was close to tears re the stairs. pop round Tues evening w/ soup & check she's got her meds. feed her cat Tigger Mon & Tues morning
Hassan - first day @ the bank tmrw at 8:30. text him tmrw night re how it went
Chloe update - Pickle biopsy clear!! she cried on the phone
Uncle Mehmet + Auntie Hana - 25th anniv in a fortnight. family chipping in for a weekend away. must send my share by Fri
Ali - quit the gym, doing climbing instead. bouldering wall on Thurs. loves it
Nia passed!! first time. her mum's lending her the old Corsa
Adriana & Ignacio postponed the wedding to next spring - venue flooded. she's gutted. check in this weekend
Femi's daughter Nia starting nursery Mon. he's more nervous than she is
Demi - work drama, her boss leaving end of month & she might get the role. interview for it Tues at 10. wish her luck Mon night
Kevin - birthday drinks cancelled, he's got covid. Sat off. send him something, he likes those Korean snacks

Laura said Ignacio's mum moved in w/ them after the fall in Sept. tight squeeze - 3 bed, 2 kids, now gran in the dining room. Laura v tired, doing all the hospital runs as Ignacio's on nights. she's not complaining exactly but you can tell. OT assessment for his mum next Weds at 2. I should offer to have the kids one Sat
Alfie & Abigail - engagement drinks @ the Crown Fri from 6. I'm bringing the fizz
Aurelio - allergic to nuts (proper epipen allergy). remember for bbq

Eduardo back from Porto. said funeral was lovely, whole village came, his grandad's old band played. he's ok-ish - sleeping badly, and his gran's now on her own which worries him. thinking of going back over at Xmas for a fortnight. coffee w/ him next wk, maybe Tues after work
Henrik - half marathon Sun morning, 1st one. been training since June. text him good luck Sat night and congrats Sun afternoon

long call w/ Alessia. her & Gabriel 5 yrs Thurs, he's planning something but she doesn't know. her brother Finn's in on it. she's also stressed re her mum - hip op on the 18th, she's taking the wk off. remind me: the 18th that evening, text her about her mum
Finn's wife Eilidh expecting! due March. she's had awful morning sickness tho. send flowers this wk
Akira - new cat, Miso. ginger, v fluffy. pics on WhatsApp
Nikhil - leaving do Thurs at 6 @ the Brewdog. I'll go after my 5pm. get a card for the office to sign by Weds

Hassan & Anan's wedding - date set! 4th Sept next yr, Marrakech, 3 day thing. save the dates out in Jan. Hassan's mum wants it in Manchester so bit of tension there. Anan said they'll do a small bash at home the wk after for the older relatives who can't fly. look at flights early, they get pricey
Kemal - hates surprises, do NOT throw him a party for his 40th. low key meal instead, he likes Turkish
Abigail's dad - stroke last Tues. she's going back & forth to the Royal. ring her tmrw lunchtime, offer to walk the dog
Dr Rossi said scan results back Thurs afternoon. book follow-up when they ring
Lila's viva done - passed w/ minor corrections!! Dr Lila now. drinks Sat at 8, she & her partner Ali hosting
Reggie + Demi - honeymoon Bali 3 wks from the 9th. house-sitting their cat Biscuit. need key off Reggie Thurs
bumped into Alice @ Tesco. Henrik's dad not great, dementia getting worse. they're looking at care homes this weekend. she seemed exhausted. ask Henrik how it went next Mon
